#!/bin/sh

# A small, dependency-free status writer for this legacy Alpine system.
base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
config="$base/message.conf"
journal="$base/journal.txt"
message=
running=1
reload_requested=0

load_message() {
    candidate=$(sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//' "$config" 2>/dev/null) || return 1
    [ -n "$candidate" ] || return 1
    message=$candidate
    return 0
}

request_reload() {
    reload_requested=1
}

request_stop() {
    running=0
}

trap 'request_reload' HUP
trap 'request_stop' TERM INT

if ! load_message; then
    printf '%s\n' "status-writer: initial configuration is empty or unreadable" >&2
    exit 1
fi

while [ "$running" -eq 1 ]; do
    if [ "$reload_requested" -eq 1 ]; then
        reload_requested=0
        if ! load_message; then
            printf '%s\n' "status-writer: rejected empty or unreadable configuration; keeping last valid message" >&2
        fi
    fi

    [ "$running" -eq 1 ] || break
    printf '%s\n' "$message" >> "$journal" || exit 1
    sleep 1
done

exit 0
WORKER_EOF
chmod 0755 "$tmp_worker"
chown root:root "$tmp_worker"
mv "$tmp_worker" "$app/worker.py"

tmp_service=$(mktemp /etc/init.d/.status-writer.XXXXXX)
cat > "$tmp_service" <<'SERVICE_EOF'
#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="legacy status writer"
description="Append the reloadable branch status message to its journal"
command="/srv/legacy2/signal-driven-config-reload/worker.py"
command_background=true
pidfile="/run/status-writer.pid"

depend() {
    need localmount
}

extra_started_commands="reload"
description_reload="Reload message.conf without restarting the writer"

reload() {
    ebegin "Reloading ${name} configuration"
    start-stop-daemon --signal HUP --pidfile "$pidfile"
    eend $?
}
SERVICE_EOF
chmod 0755 "$tmp_service"
chown root:root "$tmp_service"
mv "$tmp_service" /etc/init.d/status-writer
rc-update add status-writer default
rc-service status-writer start
